sections.title: Four core patterns
sections.content: Four patterns, one habit of mind: say who you are with vagyok/vagy (and nothing at all for ő), ask with ki? for a person or mi? for a thing, introduce something new with ez/az + egy, and turn any of those into a question just by changing your tone — no word order to rearrange, no extra word to add.

In five short lessons you've covered four patterns Hungarian speakers use constantly — and they all lean on the same small set of words (vagyok/vagy, ez/az, egy) rather than one-off phrases. That's Hungarian rewarding depth over breadth: know these few words cold, and you can already say who you are, ask what things are, and point them out.
